resources.string: Counts the short videos you watch. Everything stays on your phone.
Counts the videos you watch on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Nothing leaves your phone.

Reelometer uses this service to count the short videos you watch on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. While you use those three apps, it detects when you move on to the next video and reads the creator\'s name, the description and the hashtags to work out what the topic is. If you turn on “Who you send to” in Settings, on Instagram it also reads the name of the person or group you send a video to. It reads nothing from the other apps: it only notices that you have left, so it can stop counting. If you also turn on “Quick send”, on Instagram it puts a button over the reels and, when you tap it, it reads the names on the share sheet to find the person or group you have pinned, and taps “Share”, that person or group and “Send” for you, and nothing else (if it can\'t see them, it types their name into the search box on the sheet). Only with quick send does it crop the profile photos of the people or groups you pin from the share sheet, to show them on their button; it keeps them only on this phone and takes no other screenshots. It does not save what you type. Everything is stored only on this phone and is never sent anywhere: the app has no permission to use the internet. You can turn it off whenever you like.
